scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with a bus parked along the curb, pedestrians walking on the sidewalk, and buildings lining the street in the distance. The sky is partly cloudy with a few wispy clouds scattered across it. The sun is shining down casting shadows on the ground and illuminating the scene. The street is paved with gray bricks and has a slight curve to it. A white bus with blue lettering is parked along the curb, facing away from the camera. Two women are walking towards the camera, while a man walks away from it. The woman on the left is wearing a black jacket and pants, while the woman on the right is dressed in a white coat and brown boots. The man is wearing a dark suit and carrying a briefcase. The buildings in the background are tall and have a mix of modern and traditional architecture. The overall atmosphere is calm and peaceful.
